messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Specific diseases, disorders and medical conditions in Rhineland-Palatinate during the 2000s and 2010s?
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: Rheinland Pfalz Krebsregister Daten Inzidenz 2000 2019 download
Rheinland Pfalz Gesundheitsatlas Diabetes Herzinfarkt 2010 Daten
Rheinland Pfalz infektionskrankheiten meldepflichtige Erkrankungen Jahresbericht 2005 2015 Daten
action.query: Rheinland Pfalz Krebsregister Daten Inzidenz 2000 2019 download

content.text: {"items":[{"title":"Cancer Registry of Rhineland-Palatinate – Annual Cancer Incidence and Mortality Reports (2000–2015)","url_or_doi":"https://www.krebsregister-rlp.de/datenauswertung/oeffentliche-berichterstattung","justification":"Official cancer registry reports containing epidemiological data on specific cancers in Rhineland-Palatinate during the 2000s and 2010s. Includes incidence, mortality, age-specific rates, sex distributions, and geographical variations for cancers such as breast, lung, colorectal, and prostate cancer. Historical reports cover diagnosis years beginning in 2000. Particularly relevant for examining disease-specific trends over time."},{"title":"Cancer Registry of Rhineland-Palatinate – Oncology Monitor","url_or_doi":"https://www.idg-rlp.de/unsere-services/onkologie-monitor","justification":"Interactive database providing aggregated epidemiological and clinical cancer statistics for Rhineland-Palatinate. Includes more than 50 cancer categories, incidence and mortality rates, prevalence, age distributions, and district-level comparisons. Useful for investigating specific malignant diseases and historical trends, subject to the years available in the dashboard."},{"title":"Cancer in Rhineland-Palatinate – Incidence and Mortality in 2002","url_or_doi":"https://www.krebsregister-rlp.de/fileadmin/user_upload/dokumente/Krebs_in_RLP_2002.pdf","justification":"Official epidemiological report containing cancer incidence and mortality statistics for Rhineland-Palatinate in 2002. Provides disease-specific information, including age-standardized incidence rates, mortality rates, cancer classifications, and geographical distributions. Suitable for studying individual cancer diagnoses during the early 2000s."},{"title":"Cancer in Rhineland-Palatinate – Incidence and Mortality in 2008","url_or_doi":"https://www.krebsregister-rlp.de/fileadmin/user_upload/dokumente/Krebs_in_RLP_2008.pdf","justification":"Official cancer registry publication presenting detailed statistics for malignant diseases diagnosed in 2008. Includes cancer-specific incidence, mortality, age distributions, histological classifications, and regional incidence maps. Also presents historical trends in incidence and mortality, enabling comparisons across the 2000s."},{"title":"Statistical Office of Rhineland-Palatinate – Hospital Diagnosis Statistics","url_or_doi":"https://www.statistik.rlp.de/themen/gesundheit/publikationen/berichte","justification":"Official statistical publication portal providing annual hospital diagnosis datasets for Rhineland-Palatinate, including report series A4043. Covers patients treated in hospitals and rehabilitation facilities, with geographical breakdowns extending to districts. Particularly useful for examining specific diseases and disorders using hospital discharge diagnoses and identifying changes in hospitalization patterns during the 2000s and 2010s."},{"title":"Statistical Yearbook of Rhineland-Palatinate 2021 – Health Statistics, Hospital Diagnoses 2009–2019","url_or_doi":"https://www.statistik.rlp.de/fileadmin/dokumente/jahrbuch/Jahrbuch_2021_Kapitel_5_-_Gesundheit.pdf","justification":"Contains official tabulated hospital diagnosis statistics for Rhineland-Palatinate, including comparative data for 2009, 2014, 2018, and 2019. Covers infectious diseases, malignant neoplasms, blood disorders, metabolic diseases, mental and behavioral disorders, and other diagnostic categories. Provides hospitalization counts and sex-specific breakdowns, making it especially relevant for studying disease burden during the 2010s."},{"title":"Statistical Yearbook of Rhineland-Palatinate 2020 – Health and Disease Statistics","url_or_doi":"https://www.statistik.rlp.de/fileadmin/dokumente/jahrbuch/Jahrbuch2020.pdf","justification":"Official statistical yearbook containing disease-related hospitalization indicators for selected years between 2001 and 2018. Includes respiratory diseases, circulatory diseases, metabolic disorders, psychiatric conditions, neoplasms, and other diagnostic groups. Provides historical comparisons, hospitalization counts, and standardized indicators relevant to studying disease patterns across both decades."},{"title":"Statistical Yearbook of Rhineland-Palatinate 2022 – Hospital Patients by Diagnosis, 2010–2020","url_or_doi":"https://www.statistik.rlp.de/fileadmin/dokumente/jahrbuch/Jahrbuch_2022_Kapitel_5_-_Gesundheit.pdf","justification":"Provides official statistics on hospital patients residing in Rhineland-Palatinate, organized by diagnostic categories. Includes comparative observations for 2010, 2015, 2019, and 2020, allowing investigation of changes during the 2010s. Covers infectious diseases, malignancies, blood disorders, mental disorders, metabolic conditions, and additional disease categories, with sex-specific patient counts."},{"title":"Robert Koch Institute – SurvStat Infectious Disease Surveillance Database","url_or_doi":"https://survstat.rki.de/","justification":"Official interactive infectious disease surveillance database maintained by Germany's Robert Koch Institute. Enables analysis of reported infectious diseases by reporting year and geographical region, including Rhineland-Palatinate. Historical surveillance data begin in 2001. Relevant conditions include tuberculosis, hepatitis, measles, influenza, salmonellosis, and other notifiable infections. Particularly valuable for constructing disease-specific time series covering the 2000s and 2010s."},{"title":"Robert Koch Institute – Notifiable Infectious Diseases by Federal State, 2004–2005","url_or_doi":"https://edoc.rki.de/handle/176904/3280?show=full","justification":"Official historical infectious disease surveillance publication containing reported cases of notifiable diseases by German federal state for 2004 and 2005. Includes Rhineland-Palatinate and supports comparisons of disease-specific case counts between years and across regions. Useful for studying infectious disease epidemiology during the mid-2000s."},{"title":"Rhineland-Palatinate State Investigation Office – Annual Report 2002: Infectious Diseases","url_or_doi":"https://lua.rlp.de/fileadmin/lua/Publikationen/Jahresberichte/2002_-_2011/LUA_Jahresbericht_2002_komplett.pdf","justification":"Official annual report containing surveillance information on infectious diseases in Rhineland-Palatinate during 2002. Includes information about salmonellosis, rotavirus infections, Campylobacter enteritis, norovirus infections, and other reportable diseases. Provides seasonal disease patterns and reported case numbers, making it relevant for historical infectious disease research."},{"title":"Rhineland-Palatinate State Investigation Office – Annual Report 2009: Notifiable Infectious Diseases","url_or_doi":"https://lua.rlp.de/fileadmin/lua/Publikationen/Jahresberichte/2002_-_2011/LUA_Jahresbericht_2009_komplett.pdf","justification":"Contains detailed tables of reported infectious diseases in Rhineland-Palatinate for 2008 and 2009. Covers gastrointestinal infections, hepatitis A–E, influenza, tuberculosis, measles, meningococcal disease, Legionnaires' disease, and numerous other conditions. Provides disease-specific case counts for both years, supporting direct comparisons and analyses of infectious disease burden in the late 2000s."},{"title":"Rhineland-Palatinate State Investigation Office – Annual Report 2010: Infectious Disease Surveillance","url_or_doi":"https://lua.rlp.de/fileadmin/lua/Publikationen/Jahresberichte/2002_-_2011/LUA_Jahresbericht_2010_komplett.pdf","justification":"Official report presenting infectious disease surveillance findings for Rhineland-Palatinate in 2010. Includes information on reported influenza infections and other notifiable infectious diseases. Particularly relevant for examining changes in influenza activity following the 2009 H1N1 pandemic and for studying infectious disease trends at the transition between the 2000s and 2010s."},{"title":"Rhineland-Palatinate State Investigation Office – Historical Infectious Disease and Prevention Reports","url_or_doi":"https://lua.rlp.de/service/publikationen/list/thema-infektionspraevention/seite-3","justification":"Official repository of historical publications addressing infectious disease surveillance and prevention in Rhineland-Palatinate. Includes annual reports from the 2010s, such as the 2011 and 2012 reports, containing disease surveillance findings and laboratory investigation statistics. Useful for locating additional historical data on specific infectious diseases and pathogens."},{"title":"Rhineland-Palatinate State Investigation Office – Infectious Disease Prevention Publications, Including 2019 Reports","url_or_doi":"https://lua.rlp.de/service/publikationen/list/thema-infektionspraevention","justification":"Official publication collection containing infectious disease prevention reports, laboratory statistics, and vaccination-related publications, including reports for 2019. Provides access to historical information on infectious disease monitoring and prevention in Rhineland-Palatinate. Relevant for identifying disease-specific surveillance datasets and supplementary epidemiological information from the late 2010s."},{"title":"Statistical Office of Rhineland-Palatinate – Regional Health Reporting Database","url_or_doi":"https://www.statistik.rlp.de/themen/gesundheit/gesundheitsberichterstattung","justification":"Official regional health reporting resource providing statistical indicators for Rhineland-Palatinate. Its indicator framework follows the health reporting system adopted by German state health authorities in 2003. Relevant for locating historical indicators concerning mortality, morbidity, healthcare utilization, and disease-related health outcomes, with potential for regional and temporal comparisons."},{"title":"Statistical Office of Rhineland-Palatinate – Historical Statistical Yearbooks","url_or_doi":"https://www.statistik.rlp.de/publikationen/statistisches-jahrbuch","justification":"Official archive of statistical yearbooks containing historical health statistics for Rhineland-Palatinate. Useful for retrieving comparable disease-related indicators from the 2000s and 2010s, including hospitalizations by diagnostic category, causes of death, and selected morbidity statistics. Particularly valuable for constructing historical datasets by combining annual statistical tables."}]}
